title: Zano Rakanyorwa Nouchenjeri
intro: Fungidzira wakamira padivi pemunhu anozivikanwa kwete nezvishamiso kana umambo, asi nemashoko achiri kutungamira mwoyo nanhasi. Muranda waAllah uyu akagamuchira chipo chinokosha uye akadurura kutenda mune zvese zvinopihwa kumudzidzi wechidiki anodiwa.
clues: Ndakakomborerwa naAllah neuchenjeri, uye ndakarayirwa kuti ndihutende.
Ndakataura nemwanakomana wangu ndichimutsiura zvinyoro nyoro, ndichimuyambira nerudo uye nehanya.
Ndakaudza mwanakomana wangu kuti kubatanidza Allah nevamwe vanhu chikanganiso chikuru.
Ndakapa zano mwanakomana wangu kuti aite munamato, arayire zvakanaka, arambidze zvakaipa, uye ashivirire nemoyo murefu.
Ndakayambira mwanakomana wangu kuti asatendeuke dama nekudada kana kufamba pasi nekuzvikudza.
Ndakadzidzisa mwanakomana wangu kuti amhanye zvine mwero uye aderedze inzwi, nekuti ruzha rwakanyanya kurwadza irworwo rwemadhongi.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
